name: rating-furniture-count-fix
notes: Validates the RATING_FURNITURE_NOTE fix in src/services/staticAdIntents.js. Root cause: the note used to unconditionally instruct the model to draw 'the parenthetical count as a small qualifier on that number' even when no reviewCount was supplied, so the rating -> string was a bare '4.9 ★' with no parenthetical yet the model invented one anyway (measured 3 of 4 real gpt-image-2/edit renders on this exact spec pre-fix: '4.9 ★ (2,847)', '(287)', '(1,738)'). Fix conditions the parenthetical instruction on the string actually carrying one. Four identical baseline cells (no lever) so this is 4 independent live draws of the SAME patched prompt, not a variant comparison -- checking for a fabricated count is inherently stochastic and one lucky render proves nothing.
